text: Had to ask to use the toilet as it was locked and upstairs was blocked off. It was absolutely filthy. The floor was flooded and there was faeces all over the toilet seat and toilet it looked like it had been there awhile and not just a recent problem. When I went to inform a member of staff about this he walked away and ignored me. I didn't finish my food as I was disgusted by the staff members attitude to this . I didn't feel confident eating food prepared by someone with such a lax attitude to hygiene. The tables and seating were covered in leftovers, customers were wiping tables and seating themselves to sit down. The floors were sticky and lots of food residue. 1 star would be 1 too many for Winthorp Street McDonald's.
author: Sandra Hourihan

text:
Had a terrible experience. My order was shown on screen to collect but had to wait for it for 20 min. If I ask the manager she replied harshly and very negatively was not friendly towards the customer.
I frequently visit this Mcd but at night time it's very untidy and very terrible all the bins are flooded all tables are very dirty, dips are spilled on the floor.
And while customers are standing and sitting on the table crew members are mopping the floor. If any customer fall who will be responsible?
I am loosing intrest in this macd now. Not a single thing I have that I can appreciate this macd. Would suggest find some other macd.
Manager  please take care of this things or will loose the customers.
author: Prashant

text:
It was the very bad or even the worse experience in macdonald city centre in the night hours after 12 p.m. The manager is not responding to the problem and trying to become oversmart. On the screen my order was shown to collect but had to wait for 10 to 15 minutes. If the order is not prepared why everytime it's showing collect your order.
The lobby is not cleaned at all. And if I asked manager regarding this she is not answering and giving negative reply. It should be improved.
For washroom they have kept code everything we have to ask the employee to open the door.
author: Ganesh

text: Went in with my baby he was very young at the time only a few months old. My sister sat down and got itchy upon realising there was ants everywhere they started crawling up her and the buggy, god knows if they got into the buggy they were everywhere all over by the window and my baby was only a few months old. I told the staff and they didn’t seem phased at all just brushed them away ? As if that gets rid of an ant infestation
author: ellie

text: Disgusting, so dirty everywhere, no excuse when it comes to food preparation. Old oil on the floor and has not been swept or mopped in what looks like days. Whole outlet needs rejuvenating. Photos were taken early in the morning so was not end of day where the days footfall 'muck' could be somewhat accepted perhaps... Yuk.
author: Colin Krumblez

text: I wish I had taken pictures of the toilets. I wouldn’t let my dog use them. Absolutely revolting that any establishment that serves food would have toilets that are this revolting. No soap. No hot water. No hand dryer. My son said the men’s toilet had half a door/was broken and no lock.
author: erikadeeter

text: Definitely the worst McDonald's I have ever been to. Overall atmosphere is depressing. It is badly designed and so old and out of date and needs a total makeover Placed and received order and was given no salt, napkins, milk or sugar. Handed over, no thank you or anything. Never again.
author: Glen Smith

text: 24/7 - a complete lie. I've been waiting from three o'clock in the morning until 6 o'clock in the morning, no one opened. With such success, you will lose all the users, because according to my observations, who waited at night already went to another McDonald's which opens at 7 am.
author: Maksym Bailiak

text: The best thing about McDonald's is no matter where eat a McDonald's is the same and here didn't disappoint. Saying that this is probably the dirtiest McDonald's I've ever been in. If your very drunk you probably won't care but it did put me off!
author: riding* with*gabriel*greenburg

text: Not a nice McDonald's as McDonald's go. Staff act like they don't want to be there or care and the dirt of the place was terrible. From top to bottom and bins over flowing! We won't be back! Go to Burger King across the road it looks better.

text: This was the worst McDonald's of all time..the salad was probably old, the only good thing was the soda..and the chicken nuggets didn't taste like chicken nuggets and same with the fries, I'd say y'all can do better than this

text: Despite being very quiet got my order wrong. The decor is shabby, torn seating, paint peeling off the ceiling and it's visibly dirty, no one cleaning even though it's quite. Strange standards.
